data.description: Opportunity awaits with this charming four-bedroom, two-bathroom fixer-upper. Though in need of some TLC, this house offers ample potential with its spacious rooms and charming character. Ideal for those with a creative vision and a passion for renovation, this property is just waiting to be transformed into your dream home. With a little bit of hard work and investment, you could turn this house into a stunning showpiece. Don't miss out on this unique chance to own a piece of history and make it your own! With some original wood work and stained glass in main living as well as full walk up attic the possibilities are endless with a designers touch!
